title: Yellow Crunchy Spanish Cheese Paella
description: A fermented cheese-pull Spanish dish featuring white flour and beurre-monte, perfect for a date night, this Catalan-inspired paella is a nut-free-friendly option
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for an additional minute.
Add the white flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Slowly add the chicken broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the beurre-monte and Spanish cheese until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
